Missed pickups
None in the last 30 days.

A reservation you don't pick up by the pharmacy's closing time on its day is a missed pickup: the box went back on the shelf for nobody. After 2 in 30 days, reserving is paused for 7 days. Cancelling before the deadline never counts.
